about_short_description.short_description: Permitify is an AI tool that helps review building plans and ensures they follow building codes.

product.name: Site-Specific Code Research
product.description: Provides parcel-level zoning data, overlays, land use regulations, and environmental constraints summarized for project teams.

product.name: AI-Powered Plan Review
product.description: Analyzes uploaded building plans to identify code compliance issues, missing elements, and scope mismatches before submission.

product.name: Code Wizard Chatbot
product.description: An AI chatbot that answers zoning and building code questions with source-backed responses specific to the project site.

product.name: Collaborative Project Management
product.description: Enables teams to share notes, invite collaborators, and manage project documents to streamline the permit submission process.
